title: 3D Gait-Based Autism Classification Using Attention-Enhanced Deep Learning with Cross-Fold Statistical Stability Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.14159v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition whose early diagnosis remains challenging because conventional clinical assessments are often subjective, time-consuming, and require expert evaluation. Gait provides a promising non-invasive behavioral biomarker for auto- mated ASD screening; however, existing studies have primarily relied on single-dataset evaluations, convolutional architectures, and descriptive summaries of cross-validation performance without formally assessing fold-to-fold stability. This study addresses these gaps with an attention-enhanced Transformer framework for ASD classification, evaluated on two structurally different 3D gait feature representations: precomputed statistical gait descriptors and raw biomechanical ground-reaction- force measurements. Under five-fold cross-validation, the proposed framework achieved 99.00% accuracy, 99.02% precision, 99.00% recall, 99.00% F1-score, and 99.00% s

translated_title: 基于三维步态的孤独症分类：采用注意力增强深度学习与交叉折统计稳定性分析
translated_abstract: 孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种神经发育性疾病，其早期诊断仍然具有挑战性，因为传统的临床评估往往主观、耗时且需要专家参与。步态为自动化ASD筛查提供了一种有前景的无创行为生物标志物；然而，现有研究主要依赖于单数据集评估、卷积架构，以及对交叉验证性能的描述性总结，而缺乏对折间稳定性的正式评估。本研究通过一种注意力增强的Transformer框架来弥补这些不足，该框架在两种结构不同的三维步态特征表示上进行评估：预计算的统计步态描述符和原始生物力学地面反作用力测量数据。在五折交叉验证下，所提出的框架达到了99.00%的准确率、99.02%的精确率、99.00%的召回率、99.00%的F1分数和99.00%的……
tldr: 该研究提出一种注意力增强的Transformer框架，利用两种不同结构的三维步态特征表示实现孤独症谱系障碍的自动分类，在五折交叉验证中达到约99%的准确率，并首次对折间稳定性进行了正式的统计分析。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an attention-enhanced Transformer framework for automated ASD classification using two structurally different 3D gait feature representations, achieving approximately 99% accuracy under five-fold cross-validation with formal cross-fold statistical stability analysis.
